name: Hex
description: Hex lets agents search projects, read their results, and ask data questions in the signed-in Hex workspace. It needs a Team or Enterprise plan, and each user signs in through the browser.

prompts.text: Find the Hex project that tracks weekly active users.
How did revenue by region change last quarter?
Explain what the churn analysis project calculates and which tables it uses.

apps.name: Hex
apps.description: Project search, results, and data questions, over Hex's MCP server with browser sign-in.
